run_diatomic_tests: run the diatomic potential energy curve tests for a given MLIP model and task
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms using a predictor model
get_model: load a pretrained MLIP model for prediction using either released or custom model paths
generate_plot: generate and save a potential energy curve plot for a diatomic molecule
combined_plot: generate a combined plot showing multiple diatomic potential energy curves in one figure
